title: Account Executive – SME Credit
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members: 900,000 UK and 1,100,000 in India and growing rapidly</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>Over 2,800 Tideans globally</li> <li>Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>Über das Team</strong></h3> <p>Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das den Markterfolg von Tide in Deutschland ausbaut. Das Team bringt Expertise aus Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und lokalem Marktverständnis zusammen und gestaltet gemeinsam das Wachstum von Tide in Deutschland. Partner Credit Services ist der KMU-Kreditmarktplatz von Tide: In Zusammenarbeit mit Kreditpartnern vermitteln wir die passende Finanzierung für kleine und mittelgroße Unternehmen.</p> <h3><strong>Über die Rolle</strong></h3> <p>Als Sales Executive bist Du Teil unseres Vertriebsteams und berichtest direkt an den Team Lead Sales. Du betreust ein bereits qualifiziertes, warmes Pipeline aus unserem CRM – Dein Fokus liegt darauf, diese Kunden kompetent zu beraten und zum Abschluss zu bringen. Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Kundeneinbindung:</strong> Kontaktiere, binde ein und betreue unsere KMU-Kunden während des gesamten Kreditantragsprozesses</li> <li><strong>Pipeline-Pflege:</strong> Bearbeite kontinuierlich qualifizierte Leads aus unserem CRM und anderen Kanälen, um eine konsistente Sales Pipeline zu sichern</li> <li><strong>Vertrauen aufbauen:</strong> Erkläre überzeugend die verschiedenen Finanzierungsoptionen unserer Partner und bleib über Markt und Wettbewerb informiert</li> <li><strong>Finanzierungsexpertise:</strong> Erwirb ein tiefes Verständnis für die Vielfalt der Kreditgeber und Produkte am Markt</li> <li><strong>Partner-Engagement:</strong> Pflege aktiv die Beziehung und Abläufe mit unseren Kreditpartnern</li> <li><strong>CRM-Datenpflege:</strong> Halte Kundeninformationen in Salesforce über alle Vertriebsstufen aktuell</li> <li><strong>Teamkultur:</strong> Teile Erfahrungen und Erfolge aktiv mit dem Team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wen suchen wir</strong></p> <p>Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die dazu beiträgt, Tide zur vertrauenswürdigsten KMU-Kreditplattform in Deutschland zu machen.</p> <h3><strong>Das bringst Du mit</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Vertriebsleidenschaft und echten Antrieb, Ziele zu erreichen</li> <li>Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten</li> <li>Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Genauigkeit und Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit</li> <li>Organisationstalent und einen kühlen Kopf auch unter Druck, sowie die Fähigkeit, Probleme schnell und pragmatisch zu lösen</li> <li>Fließende, verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse</li> </ul> <p><strong>Das ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Erfahrung im Fintech-, Banking-, Payments- oder Kreditbereich</li> <li>Erfahrung im Outbound-Vertrieb oder in der Kaltakquise – diese Energie schätzen wir sehr, auch wenn sich diese Rolle auf die Betreuung bereits qualifizierter, interessierter Kunden konzentriert</li> </ul> <p>Du musst nicht alle Punkte vollständig erfüllen – wenn Du Dich in der Beschreibung wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Wir ermutigen insbesondere Frauen, sich für diese Position zu bewerben.</p> <p><strong>Gehalt:</strong> 80.000–105.000 € OTE, je nach Erfahrung.</p> <h3><strong>Was bieten wir</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bis zu 15% Provision auf den erreichten Revenue</li> <li>DeutschlandTicket</li> <li>FREE M Urban Sports Club</li> <li>Zusätzliche 3 Tage bezahlter Urlaub für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten oder Weiterbildung</li> <li>Wir investieren in deine Weiterentwicklung mit einem dafür vorgesehenen Budget</li> <li>Erweiterter Elternurlaub</li> <li>4 Wochen Sabbatical (nach 3 Jahren Zugehörigkeit)</li> <li>Unterstützung der psychischen Gesundheit durch Plumm</li> <li>Einmaliges Home-Office-Budget</li> <li>Arbeiten weltweit – bis zu 90 Tage außerhalb deines Heimatlandes</li> <li>Team-Events und soziale Aktivitäten</li> <li>Möglichkeit, dein Arbeitsgerät zu übernehmen (abhängig von der Berechtigung)</li> <li>25 Tage bezahlter Urlaub plus 5 optionale Tage unbezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr</li> <li>Barista im Office</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.</em></p> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Disclaimer</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><em>It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:</em></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li style="font-style: italic;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><em>Tide does&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold">not</strong>&nbsp;charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.</em></li> <li style="font-style: italic;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><em>All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.tide.co/careers/" target="_blank"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Careers Page</strong></a>&nbsp;and applications should be submitted through this channel.</em></li> <li style="font-style: italic;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><em>Communication from Tide will only come from an official&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold">@tide</strong><strong data-stringify-type="bold">.co</strong>&nbsp;email address.</em></li> <li style="font-style: italic;" data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0"><em>Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at <a ----- ----- safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our <a href="https://assets.ctfassets.net/3h69mkdgxn20/5MFtWSdG8YLKq3jZkK52NY/3f18633073e6cdbd03bba4b9791c64f4/Using_AI_throughout_the_Hiring_Process.pdf" target="_blank">AI Policy</a>.</em></em></p> <p><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with </em><em data-stringify-type="italic"><a class="c-link" href="https://assets.ctfassets.net/3h69mkdgxn20/30JAUcDJMlaCwUKt4zoW0j/dd541981a67b6838d6e54537704bc8aa/Tide_Recruitment_Privacy_Notice_Job_Post_Version.pdf" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://assets.ctfassets.net/3h69mkdgxn20/1MYf6q4ZMWugpeaROVETBN/526e9c160a2de03576413c81657c6466/Recruitment_Privacy_Notice__Final_Draft__Sep_2024_.pdf" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice</a></em><em data-stringify-type="italic">.</em></em></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior AI Specialist (Operations) (x/f/m)
description: <p>Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m)</strong> at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.</p> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">Doctolib is becoming an <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">AI-native</strong> company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Senior AI Specialist</strong>, you will be the technical builder and <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">AI Ops Owner</strong> behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.</div> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">&nbsp;</div> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @md:pt-2 @md:pb-[10px] @md:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">You will work in <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">founder and product mode</strong>: you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.</div> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">Your Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them:</strong>&nbsp;You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Build and operate AI agents as products:</strong>&nbsp;You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Knowledge and context management:</strong>&nbsp;You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Evaluation and quality assurance:</strong>&nbsp;You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">CRM and data integration:</strong>&nbsp;You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Central interface and enablement:</strong>&nbsp;You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Impact and measurement:</strong>&nbsp;Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.</li> </ul> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">Your Profile</h2> <p><em>Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">potential over years of experience alone</strong>. What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.</em></p> <h3 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">What Really Matters to Us, Regardless of the Specific Tool:</h3> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Learning speed and a production mindset:</strong>&nbsp;You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">An instinct for evaluation:</strong>&nbsp;You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Ownership and communication:</strong>&nbsp;You take ownership of a problem end to end, prioritize rigorously, feel comfortable with ambiguity, and make technical topics understandable to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Technical and data understanding:</strong>&nbsp;You can read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks, and automation tools such as Make, n8n, and Zapier, and know how CRM data, ideally Salesforce data, flows into AI systems.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Strong communication skills:</strong>&nbsp;You have a confident command of English and can operate at the highest level in our international environment. German at B1 level is sufficient.</li> </ul> <h3 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">We Are Particularly Interested in:</h3> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Expertise with agent platforms:</strong>&nbsp;You have practical experience with systems such as Dust, Claude, or LangChain. Since tools evolve quickly, we primarily rely on your process understanding and evaluation skills as a sustainable foundation.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Technical depth and data fluency:</strong>&nbsp;You are proficient in languages such as Python or JavaScript and can confidently navigate Salesforce architectures or BI environments such as Tableau and Metabase to manage data flows effectively.</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed"><strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Operations experience:</strong>&nbsp;You have solid experience working with scaled Customer Success or Operations teams and understand their specific dynamics.</li> </ul> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">What We Offer</h2> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">A Germany-wide public transport pass sponsored by Doctolib if you work from the office or in hybrid mode</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Company-sponsored health insurance with excellent additional benefits</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">28 days of paid vacation, plus one additional day for every full calendar year of employment, up to a maximum of 30 days</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Participation in Doctolib’s long-term employee equity program, DoctoGrowth</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">The opportunity to work from abroad for up to 10 days per year</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">An occupational pension scheme with an employer contribution of 40%, or 15% during the probationary period</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">The Doctolib Parent Care Program, which includes one additional month of parental leave and much more</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Free mental health and coaching sessions through an external partner</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">In addition to healthy snacks and a regular breakfast buffet, we offer meal vouchers</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">A subsidized sports program with our partner Urban Sports Club</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">For caregivers and employees with disabilities, we offer support that includes more flexible working hours, additional leave for medical reasons, and psychological support</li> </ul> <h2 class="pb-2 pt-4 heading-xl text-foreground">The Interview Process</h2> <ul> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Interview with Talent</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Hiring Manager interview</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">On-site case study</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Final interview with VP</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Reference checks</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Offer</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Job leading-relaxed">Full-time</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Location: Berlin</li> <li class="break-words text-foreground text-base leading-relaxed">Start date: title: Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
description: <p><strong>What is an Enterprise Account Executive at Talkdesk…</strong></p> <p>As an Enterprise Account Executive at Talkdesk, you will be responsible for pipeline generation across: SDR, Channel Partners, Marketing and Self-generation, targeting entities with 1000+ employees that are aligned to your region.</p> <p>We are looking for a driven, motivated and ambitious Enterprise Account Executives. Someone who will proactively acquire new prospects and drive forward our business offerings through solution based selling. Bring your passion for customer experience and join Talkdesk on our rocketship to success!</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Generate a strong pipeline to ensure extensive coverage. Resulting in consistent quota achievement</li> <li>Create excellent internal relationships; you cannot close those big deals on your own!</li> <li>Manage the complete and complex sales-cycles. raw.title: Software Engineer, Platform
raw.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. 

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
  • Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)
  • Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud
  • A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created
  • A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone
  • The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it
  • Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it
  • A preference for being corrected over being right
  • Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? 

Refer them!

title: Software Engineer, ML Ops and Platform
description: About the Company: Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet. World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate. Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI. TFH and World have been featured on the cover of TIME Magazine , highlighted in Fast Company’s Next 5 in Fintech, and explored in a Bloomberg deep dive . The New York Times , Bankless and TechCrunch have all recognized our collective progress in identity, cryptography, AI, and global-scale hardware deployment. Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100 . Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event. About the Team We are building a planet‑scale biometric recognition system that will serve more than a billion users and enable them to become part of the World protocol. We use cutting-edge Machine Learning models deployed on custom hardware to enable high-quality image acquisition, identification, and fraud prevention, all while requiring minimal user interaction. We are building a biometric recognition and fraud detection engine that works on the 1bn people scale. Therefore, its performance needs to outperform all the current recognition technologies. We leverage our powerful custom-made iris recognition and presentation attack detection device, the Orb, combined with the latest research from the field of AI and Deep Learning. To reach our next milestone—continuous, trustworthy ML innovation across millions of edge devices—we’re hiring a Senior ML Platform & Ops Engineer to own the ML lifecycle from data to device. You’ll design and operate production-grade pipelines that transform state-of-the-art ML research into deployed models with clear telemetry, rollback, and reproducibility. If you thrive on building self‑service platforms that turn research ideas into reliable, observable production systems, we’d love to meet you. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate reliable, observable infrastructure for training, evaluation, telemetry ingestion, and deployment. Maintain CI/CD workflows and automated pipelines. Edge‑aware rollout services with staged deployment, A/B experimentation and instant rollback across Orbs, Orb Mini and Mobile Apps. Develop secure APIs and backend services that expose governed datasets and model artefacts at scale. Implement automated checks, drift detection, and alerting for real-time model monitoring. Champion best practices in data lineage, reproducibility, privacy‑by‑design, security and secure edge delivery. Collaborate across ML research, product, and firmware teams to streamline delivery and feedback loops. About You 5+ years building ML infrastructure, data platforms, or production ML systems at scale. Track record of delivering platforms and CI/CD pipelines used daily by ML or data teams. Hands-on experience running large-scale training on multi-tenant GPU clusters to maximize throughput and reliability. You’ve built versioned dataset & lineage systems with slice-level provenance and governed access, making every model reproducible to the exact data, features, code, and config used. Deep understanding of containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS) plus Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform/CDK/Cloudformation). Strong backend engineering skills in Python and/or Go; you value clean, maintainable code. Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, model packaging, and observability practices. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following. Innovative: We embrace change and find better ways to do things together. Globally Connected: We foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives. If you’re passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board! Role Summary As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a key role in keeping all production systems running smoothly. You will work closely with other engineers and operators to fuse engineering principles, operational knowledge, security, and automation to work towards platform/service production excellence from an angle of infrastructure, reliability, and security.  The SRE team owns the foundation of AI Platform’s Core platform - the services and infrastructure that let us deploy to a multitude of public cloud providers and that powers many ML and LLM powered features. We give every other engineering team a reliable base to build on, and we own the software delivery lifecycle end to end: the tooling, patterns, and automation that reduce friction for the whole org. This is an exciting opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to a mission-driven organization. Responsibilities: What you’ll own Reliability of platform(includes ML and LLM workloads) - model serving and inference infrastructure (GPU-backed endpoints, autoscaling, latency and cost tradeoffs), with SLOs, on-call, and incident response that cover models, not just services Observability(includes ML models) - drift and performance monitoring for ML, plus LLM-specific tracing, evals, and guardrails, wired into the same metrics and logging stacks we run everywhere else Company-wide technical direction: shaping the roadmap and building golden paths that raise the baseline for every team Developer tooling and automation that compounds - reusable GitHub Actions, GitOps workflows, Terraform modules - so every engineer ships faster Reusable components packaging common open-source tools (Grafana, Istio, CloudNative stack, and ML tooling such as model registries and feature stores) for teams to deploy in any environment Secure-by-default infrastructure - baking security, compliance audits, cost governance, and audit trails into the platform in close partnership with our lead/backend/staff engineers. Requirements Who you are (must-haves) 5+ years in infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or SRE, operating large-scale, high-availability production systems using Kubernetes Production Operational experience - a live cluster under real load, not a lab. Fluent with Helm, and Terraform or Cloudformation, on at least one major cloud (AWS preferred). Good proficiency in Python or Go or general scripting for automation and tooling(automation with higher language preferred) AI is already in your daily loop - Agentic tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Droid, internal skills) is part of how you ship and not what you are experimenting with. We believe AI tools can be great with human judgement and we want the SRE team to bring the next wave day to day operations.  First-principles reasoning -  Reasoning from constraints and failure modes naming the tradeoff in business terms (reliability vs. velocity, cost vs. blast radius, standardisation vs. one-off)  At least one infrastructure build you owned end to end - with the outcome metric attached (deploy time, MTTR, cost, adoption, availability). Cross-functional strength. Track record working with product, backend/frontend teams to pull through collective initiative.  ML & AI platform (strongly preferred) Running ML workloads on Kubernetes - GPU scheduling, capacity, and cost management Model serving and inference at production scale (eg KServe, RayServe, Triton, vLLM, or similar) with real latency and cost constraints(preferred RayServe) MLOps pipeline tooling - training pipelines, model registries, feature stores, and lineage (Kubeflow, MLflow, Feast, Weights & Biases, or equivalents) LLMOps in production - inference serving, prompt/version management, and LLM observability (tracing, evals, drift, guardrails, cost per request) Governing ML/LLM workloads as platform capabilities: data-residency and PII controls, and audit trails Any other General requirements Global Collaboration: Ability to work across global teams and different cultures across various time zones with strong communication skills. Problem Solving: Ability to break down complex problems into simple, actionable solutions. Ownership & Drive: Tendency to go above and beyond to meet deadlines, manage own deliverables, and assist team members. Availability: Willingness to support processes for 24x7 operational support. Benefits At CloudFactory, we believe that work should be more than just a job—it should be a platform for growth, impact, and community. Here, you’ll earn with purpose, learn every day, and serve a mission that truly matters. If you're looking for a career where you can develop professionally, contribute meaningfully, and be part of a global movement, we’d love to have you on this journey! Join us today and be part of our mission to connect people and technology for a better world! Apply now and bring your whole, authentic self to work—we can’t wait to meet you! As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent). Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling). Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design. A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. Some experience deploying AI projects. Qualifications You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud). Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects. You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks. A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment. Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!). Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders. Good communication skills in English. Our offer Conditions Application Deadline: The position remains open until filled Expected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement. Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignment Terms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement. We encourage you to apply using the application form. As an Account Executive you will play a key role in growing Gurobi's presence by identifying new business opportunities, expanding existing customer relationships, and helping organizations solve complex optimization challenges. You'll own a broad territory and be responsible for developing and executing a strategic territory plan that drives pipeline growth across commercial accounts (SMB). Success in this role requires a proactive, consultative sales approach, strong prospecting skills, and the ability to build lasting relationships with technical and executive stakeholders. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Technical Account Management, and Marketing, you'll introduce Gurobi's optimization technology to new markets while helping existing customers expand their use of our solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating demand, navigating complex technical sales cycles, and building long-term partnerships in a relationship-driven market. What you will be doing? Own and execute the sales strategy across your assigned territory, developing a proactive plan to generate new business and grow existing customer relationships. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, account-based selling, referrals, partner relationships, networking, and marketing-generated opportunities. Identify and prioritize high-value commercial accounts, creating demand in markets where Gurobi has varying levels of brand awareness. Execute a land-and-expand strategy by identifying new buying centers, upsell opportunities, and cross-functional use cases within existing customers. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, partnering with both technical users and executive decision-makers to deliver business value. Act as a trusted advisor, understanding customer challenges and positioning Gurobi's optimization technology to meet their objectives. Collaborate with Technical Account Managers, Marketing, and Product teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience throughout the sales process. Represent Gurobi at customer meetings, conferences, trade shows, and industry events. Maintain accurate opportunity management, forecasting, and customer activity within Salesforce to support effective pipeline management and business planning. Stay informed on industry trends, competitive activity, and developments within optimization, analytics, and enterprise software. Experience selling complex or technical software solutions into SMB/enterprise organizations. Experience engaging technical, analytics, engineering, operations, supply chain, manufacturing, or optimization-related buying centers. Demonstrated success managing long, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Technical or engineering background is an advantage. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. What skills and abilities should you have? Proficiency in delivering presentations and training sessions effectively. Expertise in negotiation to secure favorable outcomes for Gurobi and its clients. Strong conflict resolution skills to protect the customer experience and enhance Gurobi's image. Ability to create compelling value propositions for partners. Proficiency in strategic and analytical thinking to assess decisions' internal and external impact. Aptitude for using data to plan and execute strategies effectively. Satisfaction and ability to operate effectively from a home office in a remote work environment. Willingness to travel throughout Nordics/Benelix for customer meetings, partner engagements, industry events, and conferences, with occasional international travel for company meetings and training. Ability to participate in meetings across different time zones within reasonable expectations. Motivated ambition to achieve assigned Objective Key Results (OKRs). What other requirements should you have? Advanced-level technical B2B SaaS sales experience: Demonstrated expertise and success in selling B2B software solutions in a technical environment. Fluency with macOS, Microsoft 365, and Power BI: Proficiency in using these tools to effectively manage and analyze data, collaborate, and deliver presentations. Comfortable with learning and utilizing Salesforce: Ability to quickly learn and leverage Salesforce, a widely used customer relationship management (CRM) platform, to effectively manage sales activities and customer interactions. Comfortable working in an international setting and with a US-based company. Where applicable, a valid passport and the ability to obtain necessary international travel documents.   Your Alignment with our Gurobi Core Values: Customer Focus: Verbal & written communication skills that bring clarity and build trust.  Power of the Team: Motivated with a team-oriented mindset that aims to both inspire and be inspired by others. Innovation: The courage to bring ideas forward and see yourself as an integral part of our global team.  Dedication: Organized and agile, focusing on meeting professional objectives while promoting a healthy work/life balance.  Integrity: Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility.   Gurobi Optimization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. raw.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
raw.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

title: Sales Development Representative (all genders)
description: Raise the bar. Own the outcome. Wemolo entwickelt die digitale Infrastruktur für die nächste Generation von Parkraum und Immobilien. Mit mehr als 4.000 bewirtschafteten Parkflächen in Europa sind wir bereits international aktiv – und wachsen weiter. Als Sales Development Representative (all genders) bist du ein wichtiger Treiber dieses Wachstums. Du identifizierst relevante Accounts, erreichst die richtigen Entscheider und entwickelst aus ersten Kontakten qualifizierte Opportunities für unsere Account Executives. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielen und dich im Sales schnell weiterentwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Die Position ist hybrid mit drei festen Office-Tagen pro Woche an unserem Standort in München-Thalkirchen. What to expect Build your pipeline: Du identifizierst relevante Accounts und Entscheider, priorisierst deine Targets und baust systematisch deine eigene Pipeline auf. Create meaningful conversations : Du erreichst potenzielle Kunden telefonisch, per E-Mail und über LinkedIn. Mit relevantem Messaging schaffst du einen konkreten Grund für den nächsten Austausch. Think in accounts : Du verstehst Unternehmen, Geschäftsmodelle und die Herausforderungen deiner Ansprechpartner. Dieses Wissen nutzt du, um deine Ansprache gezielt zu personalisieren. Master discovery : Du führst erste Gespräche, stellst die richtigen Fragen und erkennst, wo Wemolo echten Mehrwert schaffen kann. Du qualifizierst Opportunities für unsere Account Executives. Learn from every conversation : Nicht jedes Gespräch wird erfolgreich sein. Du analysierst deine Ergebnisse, holst dir Feedback und entwickelst deinen Ansatz kontinuierlich weiter. Go the extra mile: Du gibst dich nicht mit dem Offensichtlichen zufrieden. Du probierst neue Ansätze aus, recherchierst tiefer und suchst aktiv nach Wegen, deine Ergebnisse zu verbessern. Drive growth : Deine Arbeit schafft die Grundlage für neue Kunden und nachhaltiges Wachstum. Dein Beitrag ist sichtbar und messbar. Inspire us by High standards. Real ownership. Academic Excellence: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium und hast bereits gezeigt, dass du anspruchsvolle Ziele konsequent verfolgen kannst. Ambition: Du willst mehr als Durchschnitt. Du setzt dir hohe Ziele, suchst Herausforderungen und hast den Anspruch, zu den Besten in deinem Bereich zu gehören. Performance: Ergebnisse zählen für dich. Du arbeitest zielorientiert, misst deinen Fortschritt und willst deine Ziele nicht nur erreichen, sondern übertreffen. Drive & Ownership: Du ergreifst die Initiative, übernimmst Verantwortung und bleibst auch dann dran, wenn es herausfordernd wird. Wenn dir etwas wichtig ist, gehst du die Extrameile. Communication: Du trittst selbstbewusst auf, kannst Menschen für dich gewinnen und hast keine Scheu davor, Entscheider direkt anzusprechen – auch telefonisch im Cold Calling. Growth Mindset: Du willst schnell besser werden, suchst aktiv Feedback und setzt Learnings direkt in bessere Ergebnisse um. Languages: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. What we offer you Earn & grow: Du erhältst ein attraktives OTE-Modell aus Fixgehalt und leistungsbezogenem monatlichem Bonus. Gute Performance soll sich für dich lohnen. Learn fast: Strukturiertes Onboarding, regelmäßiges Coaching, Shadowing und direktes Feedback helfen dir, deine Sales Skills schnell weiterzuentwickeln. title: Multiphysics Simulation Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy. Getting there requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, heating work as one, and work at the edge of what each discipline can deliver on its own. You will own the complex calculations that set the requirements each system needs to be designed against. You will be accountable for providing the engineering design teams with reasonably estimated and correctly validated load cases that drive the design of the machine. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own simulation pipelines end to end. From physics assumptions through to the machine-defining load cases you provide the subsystem to teams. You own the whole chain, not a step in it. Build the simulators . Finite-element models where that's the right instrument, a reduced-order model coded from scratch where it isn't, all of it properly interfaced with our codebase. Set the interfaces. Define with each engineering team what goes in, what comes out, what it means and what it doesn't cover. Scan the space . Run parameter sweeps and simulation campaigns at scale to settle machine-level tradeoffs before they're locked in. Prove the numbers . Benchmark, cross-check against analytical limits and experiment, and know the boundary where your model stops being trustworthy. WHO YOU ARE You range across physics and geometry. You are not afraid of jumping between Lorentz forces in a stellarator and the 3D geometry. You've earned that breadth. A PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and time spent where multiphysics analysis actually drives hardware decisions: space, accelerators, semiconductors, aircraft, or anywhere else complex machines get built at scale. You build in code like an engineer, not a scripter. Git, CI/CD, and the PyData stack are second nature, and you've shipped real software, not a folder of one-off scripts. You reach for whatever tool fits . Pen and paper, a solver you wrote last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse. You think in pipelines. Automation, reproducibility, validation. And you can tell when a passing series of tests isn't actually telling the truth. You're proactive . You find the gap before it becomes a problem, prioritize hard, and argue for the next step. INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) *This role sits at PF3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information. At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table. About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role sits outside of the&nbsp;</span><a href="https://ddat-capability-framework.service.gov.uk/"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">DDaT pay framework</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;given the scope of this role requires in depth technical&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;in frontier AI safety,&nbsp;robustness&nbsp;and advanced AI architectures.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The full range of salaries are available below:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Level 3:</strong>&nbsp;£65,000–£75,000 (Base £39,850 + Technical Allowance £25,150–£35,150)</li> <li><strong>Level 4:</strong>&nbsp;£85,000–£95,000 (Base £47,355 + Technical Allowance £37,645–£47,645)</li> <li><strong>Level 5:</strong>&nbsp;£105,000–£115,000 (Base £61,620 + Technical Allowance £43,380–£53,380)</li> <li><strong>Level 6:</strong>&nbsp;£125,000–£135,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £50,395–£60,395)</li> <li><strong>Level 7:</strong>&nbsp;£145,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £70,395)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <h4>Additional Information</h4> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_nullclass"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><strong>Use of AI in Applications</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our&nbsp;<u><a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.civil-service-careers.gov.uk%2Fartificial-intelligence-and-recruitment%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CLynn.Tan%40dsit.gov.uk%7Ccf5d753b7f19427afc8f08de4c307014%7Ccbac700502c143ebb497e6492d1b2dd8%7C0%7C0%7C639031968075235036%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=jCrYoy62YfXN%2FLIB%2FhtHxdLGbCOgropbkZXDyQsUMC4%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="02db05e7-03ca-4ca6-bcd9-73ff8bf258f2" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="1">candidate guidance&nbsp;</a></u>for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.</span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><strong>Internal Fraud Database</strong>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">For more information please see -&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice">Internal Fraud Register.</a></span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Security</span></h3> <span style="font-size: 8pt;">Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" data-sk="tooltip_parent">baseline personnel security standard (BPSS)&nbsp;clearance</a>&nbsp;before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" data-sk="tooltip_parent">counter-terrorist check (CTC)&nbsp;clearance</a>. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><h2><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is 30</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun Superscript CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-fontsize="12" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">th</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">&nbsp;September 2026</span><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightPipeRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0}">&nbsp;</span></h2> <h2>Team Description</h2> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Control measures — monitors, permission systems, sandboxing, resampling, escalation protocols — are designed to detect and prevent misaligned behaviour from advanced AI systems. Though the measures are already critical to safety, whether they would in fact catch a capable model attempting to cause harm is an empirical question that remains largely untested. </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Control Red Team at AISI is stress-testing control monitors (</span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/how-our-new-control-red-team-is-stress-testing-frontier-monitors"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">including</span> <span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">from GDM and Anthropic</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">) – finding attacks that beat monitors and attempting to design experiments to measure real-world risk. We’re based within the Red Team, about a dozen people who have spent the last two years breaking developer’s alignment and misuse safeguards, and grew out of </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/research?category_equal=%5B%22Control%22%5D"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">AISI’s</span> <span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">previ</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">o</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">us </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">research</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink"> in</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">to</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink"> contro</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">l evaluations and safety cases.</span></span></a><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're opening roles on the Control Red Team, and we think it's an unusually good place to do this work. You'd join early, with real ownership over the team's direction; you'd have frontier model access, serious compute and strong infrastructure support from across AISI; and you'd get privileged insight into control measures across several frontier developers, working alongside some of the most experienced red teamers in the field.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our current bet is to focus our effort on </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">monitoring</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: the measures frontier companies lean on most heavily, and the ones where the science of evaluation is not yet settled.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">About the Role</span></h2> <h2><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">What You'll Be Doing</span></h2> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="TextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8">You’ll</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8"> spend your time across two tracks of work:&nbsp;</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW85424813 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8">1. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8">Research: </span><span class="NormalTextRun CommentStart SCXW56547643 BCX8">How and what should we measure to understand the efficacy of control measures? </span></span></strong><span class="EOP Selected SCXW56547643 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="EOP Selected SCXW56547643 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="TextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8">How can we gather empirical evidence about how likely a monitor is to prevent harm — and what can we legitimately conclude from it? raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to own the design, build, and maintenance of integrations between Workday and our wider systems landscape (TA, Reward, Payroll, Absence, Finance, and third-party tools). You'll work alongside the People Technology and module teams to keep data flowing accurately and securely across the platform and help extend Workday's capabilities beyond its native functionality.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Design, build, and support Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Workday APIs (SOAP/REST)

  • Develop and maintain custom reports via RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) to serve downstream systems and stakeholders

  • Build and extend business processes using Workday Extend to digitise offline or manual processes

  • Troubleshoot integration failures, including security/permission issues, data mapping errors, and connectivity problems

  • Manage integration security: ISU setup, OAuth scopes, domain security policies, and API client configuration

  • Partner with module teams (HCM, Absence, Compensation) and system owners (Finance, IT, Workforce Management) to gather integration requirements

  • Maintain integration documentation, including field mappings and process flows

  • Support data migration validation and spot-check processes for ongoing data loads

  • Monitor integration health and proactively flag/resolve recurring errors

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building Workday integrations using EIB, Connectors, and Studio

  • Working knowledge of Workday RaaS and calculated fields

  • Experience with Workday Extend (building or supporting custom applications)

  • Understanding of Workday security model (domains, business processes, ISUs, OAuth)

  • API integration experience (REST/SOAP), including troubleshooting auth and permission errors

  • Comfortable working across HR, Finance, and IT stakeholder groups

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating Workday with ATS (e.g. Ashby), payroll (ADP), Microsoft Entra, benefits platforms (Thanksben)

  • Exposure to Workday Studio advanced transformations (XSLT)

  • Experience with data migration projects (e.g. legacy HRIS to Workday)

  • Workday Pro certification in Integrations or Extend

Why this Role

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

wider Government practice.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and day-to-day work.</li> <li>Experience supporting organisations in the adoption of new technologies, digital tools, operating model changes or transformation initiatives.</li> <li>Strong analytical and ethical considerations associated with AI adoption.</li> <li>A pragmatic mindset that focuses on creating measurable value and tangible outcomes rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.</li>
