title: Senior UX Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Senior UX Designer</strong> to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team within our Live Games Portfolio division in the UK on a remote basis.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <p>Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X Strategy MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <ul> <li>Help shape the future of UX design on STFC, both through new features and through your own principles, practices, and standards.</li> <li>Own and deliver complete UX for new features and player experiences, turning ideas into fully developed designs that meet the experience targets of the product.</li> <li>Build deep knowledge of the game to effectively step into the player’s shoes and ground your design decisions in real player perspectives and experiences.</li> <li>Find relevant references and comps, deconstructing them to uncover inspiration and common pitfalls.</li> <li>Visualise ideas by producing a range of design deliverables that communicate your thinking and design intent. This includes sketches, low to medium fidelity wireframes, user flows, and interactive UX prototypes.</li> <li>Identify weak points in designs, gaps in thinking, and opportunities to better deliver on goals by applying critical thinking and a sharp design eye to strengthen solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with product teams, game designers and artists to refine ideas and stay aligned throughout development. Proactively share work, keep the right people informed, and provide relevant information when it’s needed.</li> <li>Leverage feedback, data, and other insights to refine designs—not just to react, but to reflect and make intentional improvements.</li> <li>Support long-term product and UX consistency through your design work by drawing on developed knowledge of our design principles and patterns.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience specialising in game UX development, with a track record of delivering features or initiatives from concept to implementation.</li> <li>Confidence in navigating ambiguity, with the ability to identify next steps, recognise blockers, and take initiative to move work forward.</li> <li>A solutions-oriented mindset that goes beyond identifying problems, bringing thoughtful, creative problem solving to the table.</li> <li>A strong understanding of game development norms and pipelines, including how to design with technical constraints, implementation realities, and cross-discipline workflows in mind.</li> <li>A fit for a culture built on curiosity, improvement, creativity, and collaboration, paired with a genuine passion for both playing and making games that fuels thoughtful, player-centered design.</li> </ul> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! &nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Ecommerce Manager – Commercial Trading & Strategy
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">About the Role:</span></span></strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The Senior Ecommerce Manager is a senior commercial leadership role, responsible for setting and delivering the <strong>ecommerce trading, inventory and marketing strategy</strong> across a client account or vertical.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This role goes beyond front-end ecommerce performance. You will take commercial ownership of how <strong>stock, product mix, margin, marketing investment and customer demand</strong> come together to drive sustainable growth.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will lead the development of trading strategies aligned to buying cycles, product launches and inventory plans, ensuring that merchandising, marketing and operational teams are working towards a unified commercial objective.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll be responsible for understanding and influencing stock health, sell-through, stock cover, margin performance and product lifecycle, using this insight to shape promotional strategy, visual merchandising, marketing investment and customer acquisition activity.</p> <p>Acting as the bridge between the Ecommerce Manager layer and the Head of Ecommerce, you will provide strategic direction to your team while leading senior stakeholders across buying, merchandising, finance, marketing and operations. You will own the commercial narrative for your accounts and have the confidence to challenge decisions where stock, margin or customer demand are not aligned.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">Key Responsibilities:</span></span></strong></p> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Strategic Trading, Inventory &amp; Commercial Performance</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overall ecommerce trading strategy for your accounts, with responsibility for revenue, conversion, AOV, COS, ROAS, margin, sell-through, stock cover and inventory health.</li> <li>Develop trading strategies that are directly aligned to <strong>buying cycles, range plans, product launches, seasonal priorities and inventory positions</strong>.</li> <li>Take commercial ownership of stock performance, working with merchandising and finance teams to develop strategies for stock optimisation, clearance, markdowns and margin protection.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional alignment between ecommerce, merchandising, buying and operations to ensure a unified approach to achieving optimal stock levels and product mix.</li> <li>Monitor stock depth, width, availability, sell-through and aged inventory, identifying risks and opportunities and translating these into clear commercial actions.</li> <li>Use inventory insight to influence promotional strategy, product prioritisation, onsite visibility and marketing investment.</li> <li>Ensure the trading calendar reflects both customer demand and the commercial realities of the buying and inventory cycle.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to maximise full-price sales, improve sell-through and minimise aged or excess stock while protecting margin.</li> <li>Own the strategic approach to product lifecycle management, from launch and newness through to seasonal transitions, markdowns and end-of-life.</li> <li>Oversee site performance and customer journey optimisation, using data, customer behaviour and CRO insight to identify opportunities for sustainable growth.</li> <li>Lead competitor, pricing, promotional and market analysis to ensure clients remain commercially competitive.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Merchandising, Product &amp; Visual Strategy</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Develop the overarching digital product and merchandising strategy in partnership with buying and category leaders.</li> <li>Attend brand and product showcases to understand upcoming product ranges, key USPs, product features, seasonal stories and commercial priorities.</li> <li>Translate product showcase insights into clear digital product strategies, including taxonomy, categorisation, onsite hierarchy, visual storytelling and content requirements.</li> <li>Define visual merchandising direction for key launches, seasonal campaigns and commercial events, ensuring the site reflects stock and margin priorities.</li> <li>Work with buying and category teams to establish product priority lists and inventory depth targets for key trading periods.</li> <li>Ensure ecommerce plans are informed by range architecture, product availability and anticipated customer demand.</li> <li>Develop merchandising capability and processes within the wider ecommerce team, embedding best practice and consistent ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Marketing &amp; Channel Leadership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overarching multi-channel marketing strategy across SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Lead channel strategy and investment decisions based on <strong>commercial performance, inventory health, margin and customer acquisition efficiency</strong>.</li> <li>Ensure marketing spend is dynamically aligned to product availability, stock depth, margin targets and strategic trading priorities.</li> <li>Use attribution modelling, customer data and channel performance insight to optimise budget allocation and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Balance new customer acquisition with CLV, retention and profitability objectives.</li> <li>Identify where additional marketing investment can accelerate sell-through of priority or overstocked products without unnecessarily diluting margin.</li> <li>Challenge channel teams to demonstrate clear commercial contribution and ensure marketing activity supports the wider trading strategy.</li> <li>Develop sophisticated forecasts to inform channel budgets, sales targets and inventory-led trading decisions.</li> <li>Partner with creative, brand and data teams to ensure campaign execution reflects product priorities and commercial objectives.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Returns &amp; Customer Insight</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Take strategic ownership of returns performance, identifying trends, root causes and commercial impact.</li> <li>Partner with buying, category, customer service and operational teams to reduce avoidable returns and improve product performance.</li> <li>Use returns data, customer feedback and behavioural insight to influence product content, imagery, sizing information and onsite communication.</li> <li>Identify products or categories with high return rates and develop cross-functional action plans to improve customer understanding and reduce return-related costs.</li> <li>Incorporate customer and returns insight into broader product, merchandising and trading strategies.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Buying, Merchandising &amp; Finance Partnership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Build strong strategic relationships with senior buying, category and merchandising stakeholders.</li> <li>Partner with Finance to understand margin performance, P&amp;L impact, stock valuation and commercial trade-offs.</li> <li>Work with buying leaders to ensure digital trading plans are aligned to range development, launch readiness and buying-cycle roadmaps.</li> <li>Challenge product mix, stock depth and promotional decisions using ecommerce, inventory and customer data.</li> <li>Establish shared commercial objectives across ecommerce, buying, merchandising, finance and operations.</li> <li>Lead regular reviews of stock health, margin, sell-through and trading performance, ensuring risks are identified early and action plans are clearly owned.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Client &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior commercial point of contact for your clients, building trusted, strategic relationships.</li> <li>Own the commercial and strategic narrative for your accounts, translating complex trading, inventory and marketing data into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Lead QBRs, monthly business reviews and strategic planning sessions, presenting performance, risks, opportunities and forward-looking recommendations.</li> <li>Confidently challenge clients and internal stakeholders where decisions may negatively impact stock health, margin or commercial performance.</li> <li>Balance client ambition with operational capacity and commercial reality.</li> <li>Ensure client priorities are translated into clear actions across internal ecommerce, merchandising, marketing and operational teams.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Capability Development</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead, manage and develop a team of Ecommerce Managers and Executives.</li> <li>Set clear expectations around trading, merchandising, commercial analysis and data-led decision making.</li> <li>Develop the team's capability across inventory-led trading, visual merchandising, product lifecycle management and commercial optimisation.</li> <li>Coach team members to understand the relationship between stock, margin, customer demand and marketing performance.</li> <li>Establish consistent processes and best practice across trading and merchandising activity.</li> <li>Identify capability gaps and lead projects to improve the team's overall commercial effectiveness.</li> <li>Create a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Project Ownership</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex cross-functional projects spanning ecommerce, buying, merchandising, finance, marketing, logistics and operations.</li> <li>Champion a unified approach to stock, trading and commercial performance across all relevant departments.</li> <li>Own strategic initiatives from initial opportunity identification through to implementation, measurement and optimisation.</li> <li>Establish clear project governance, milestones, responsibilities and success measures.</li> <li>Ensure projects deliver measurable improvements in revenue, margin, stock efficiency, customer experience or operational performance.</li> <li>Share market insight, commercial best practice and strategic learnings across the wider ecommerce function.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">What We’re Looking For:</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant senior ecommerce experience spanning <strong>commercial trading, merchandising and digital marketing</strong>, ideally within a retailer, DTC, agency or managed services environment.</li> <li>Proven experience managing <strong>inventory-led trading and stock performance</strong> within an ecommerce or retail environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of stock cover, sell-through, inventory depth and width, product lifecycle, aged stock and stock optimisation.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience partnering with <strong>buying, merchandising/category and finance leaders</strong> to make commercial decisions.</li> <li>Proven experience developing merchandising capability, processes and best practice.</li> <li>Strong commercial understanding of <strong>margin, P&amp;L, COS, markdowns, promotional mechanics and profitability</strong>.</li> <li>Experience influencing product mix and inventory strategy based on customer demand, trading performance and commercial objectives.</li> <li>Strong understanding of visual merchandising and the ability to translate product and buying strategy into digital execution.</li> <li>Experience analysing returns data and implementing strategies to reduce return rates.</li> <li>Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Experience using attribution, customer and performance data to optimise marketing investment and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams across ecommerce, merchandising, buying, finance, marketing and operations.</li> <li>Strong project management experience, with demonstrable ownership of complex commercial initiatives from strategy through to delivery.</li> <li>Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to develop capability and drive high performance.</li> <li>Highly analytical and commercially astute, with the ability to turn complex data into clear strategic decisions.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, with confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging decisions constructively.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment with multiple competing priorities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our <span class="mark75xs2u5gf" data-markjs="true" data-ogac="" data-ogab="" data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="">Talent</span> team to discuss further.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the role This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous. You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains. Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you'll have impact You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll: Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience). Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after. Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs. Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact. Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy. Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike. Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you. What you'll bring You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake. You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one. You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review. You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do. Qualifications & Expectations Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1. Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues. Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders. Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs. raw.description:
About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you'll have impact

You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:

  • Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

  • Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

  • Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

  • Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

  • Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

  • Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

  • Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

What you'll bring

  • You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

  • You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

  • You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

Qualifications & Expectations

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1.

  • Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues.

  • Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs.

  • A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including narrative strategy writing for senior audiences.

  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Experience with AI tools, and AI prototyping

  • A deep alignment with MUBI's culture and values: craftsmanship, product excellence, a bias toward high-impact work, and genuine respect for the user.

The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform. What the job involves Intelligence collection and analysis Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required. Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments. Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages. Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems. Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships. Intelligence production Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs. Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material. Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required. Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas. Data curation Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem. Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion. Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen. Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data. Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification. Leadership and collaboration Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs. Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation. Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required. Innovation and capability development Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality. Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else. You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent. Writing is one of your strengths. You can turn a fast-moving, ambiguous picture into a concise, evidence-based assessment under deadline, and you take pride in doing it well. Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team. Support the development of the monitoring frameworks and analytical methodologies used across the team. Shape how AI changes intelligence work itself, championing new tools and methodologies across the Research & Analysis team and influencing how the whole function operates. Fluency in written Arabic, across both Modern Standard Arabic and local dialects, including knowledge of slang, with the ability to monitor, analyse, and translate Arabic-language content from a range of sources. Demonstrable experience applying structured analytical methodologies to complex information environments and online ecosystems, including OSINT, network analysis, narrative analysis, sentiment analysis, or other quantitative and qualitative approaches. Strong written communication skills, with a track record of producing concise, high-quality, policy-relevant intelligence and analytical outputs under tight deadlines. Hands-on experience curating source coverage: identifying and verifying online sources, assessing their affiliation, and maintaining structured datasets to a defined standard. Experience proofreading, editing, and quality-assuring analytical products. Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities. Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from high-volume information flows. Able to communicate complex political, security, and extremist-related developments clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences. Comfortable integrating AI systems into your workflow to improve outputs and efficiency. About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

Tasks

What You'll Own:

  • Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them
  • Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning
  • Quality of your code and the areas you touch
  • Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain
  • Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform
  • Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What Your Work Will Entail:

1. Feature Development

  • Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently
  • Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform
  • Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards
  • Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly
  • Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts
  • Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

2. Production Ownership & Incident Response

  • Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution
  • Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution
  • L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen
  • Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build
  • Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

3. Code Quality & Testing

  • Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought
  • Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive
  • Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration
  • Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools
  • You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment
  • L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers
  • Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
  • Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

  • L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.
  • L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.
  • L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.
  • L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

On-Call:

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

Think about this role as some combination of incident responder, detection engineer, security engineer, SOC automation engineer, threat hunter, threat modeler, and security awareness engineer. Our SOC team is involved in engineering (e.g., we built our own SOAR, email content scanning system, the entire alerting stack and much more) and we handle the incident response and remediation when a threat is found.</p> <p>Our analysts research and prioritise what threats need to be monitored, hunt for them in our data, write code to detect them and constantly tune the detection to prioritise quality over quantity. We maintain full control over the alerts we respond to, and own all stages of the detection and response lifecycle.</p> <p>Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. raw.title: Claims Validation Handler
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Claims Validation Team
The Claims Validation Team exists to help to defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity, and to protect the company loss ratio. Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can then result in driving up the premium prices for our honest customers. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns.


What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim

  • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

We break it up into a few stages:

  • Initial call with someone in our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • A skill-based interview where you will discuss your previous experience also with a focus on our values, our culture and your motivations with our Claims Validation Team Lead plus one other team member (1 hour)

We’ll let you know if you’re invited to an interview or not. But, as a small team with a lot of applications to consider, we can’t give personal feedback on each application.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: ECommerce Acceleration Manager
description: Join Luzern eCommerce: Powering the World’s Most Ambitious Brands Step into the world of limitless possibilities with Luzern eCommerce, where we’ve been redefining online retail since 2003. We partner with global icons like On Running, Wella, Nestlé, Mattel, Panasonic, HTC, and Philips to accelerate growth, maximize margins, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across Amazon, top marketplaces, branded webstores, and social platforms. Backed by significant investment, we’re on a mission to dominate the global eCommerce space. With our award-winning team, cutting-edge AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, and bold strategies, we’re not just keeping up with the future of retail—we’re creating it. Be part of one of the fastest-growing tech sectors, where you’ll innovate, collaborate, and thrive in a business that values your individuality and ambition. Join Luzern eCommerce and be part of the next big chapter in retail history! Tasks About the Role We are looking for an eCommerce superstar who knows Amazon inside out, loves getting stuck into client accounts and has the drive to make things happen. You will be commercially minded, proactive and comfortable moving between the detail of Vendor and Seller Central and the bigger picture of growing brands online. What matters most to us is strong Amazon marketplace knowledge, particularly Vendor Central, combined with the right attitude: self-aware, accountable, curious and always looking for ways to improve. What You’ll Be Doing Own and develop relationships with key client accounts, becoming a trusted eCommerce partner and day-to-day point of contact. Take ownership of Amazon performance across both Vendor Central (1P) and Seller Central (3P), with a strong understanding of how Vendor operates commercially and operationally. Develop a deep understanding of each client's strategy, objectives and key stakeholders, translating these into clear marketplace growth plans. Own and support the full end-to-end eCommerce process across key accounts, including catalogue and content, pricing, promotions, inventory, availability, operational performance and customer experience. Analyse sales, profitability and marketplace performance to identify risks and opportunities, turning data into clear recommendations and actions. Proactively troubleshoot Vendor and Seller Central issues and work with Amazon, clients and internal teams to drive resolution. Plan and deliver regular client performance reviews and QBRs, providing clear insights, recommendations and next steps. Work closely with eCommerce Operations, Advertising, Content, Technology and other internal teams to deliver excellent execution for clients. Support promotional campaigns, new product launches and peak trading moments, ensuring plans are commercially sound and operationally ready. Identify opportunities to expand client performance and scope across Amazon and, where relevant, other marketplaces. Provide guidance, coaching and support to more junior members of the eCommerce Acceleration team and help raise standards across the wider team. Requirements What You Bring to the Role Essential Strong hands-on experience managing Amazon marketplace accounts, either brand-side or agency-side. Good working knowledge of both Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central. Vendor Central experience and a clear understanding of the 1P model is particularly important for this role. Experience understanding the commercial and operational levers that drive Amazon performance, including sales, margin, availability, pricing, catalogue health and promotions. Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to build trusted relationships and communicate clearly. Commercially minded and analytical, with the ability to turn data into useful insights and practical actions. Proactive and solutions-focused. A positive, collaborative attitude and the ability to work well across different teams and priorities. Strong attention to detail, organisation and prioritisation skills across multiple accounts. Confident written and verbal English, including presenting recommendations and performance updates to clients. Preferred Experience with other marketplaces such as Zalando, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop or Allegro. Experience with Amazon Advertising or working closely with performance marketing teams. Experience with eCommerce analytics and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, Helium 10, Keepa or similar. Experience working in an agency or multi-client environment. People management, mentoring or coaching experience for candidates applying at Manager level. Benefits What We Offer Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package with benefits. This position is critical to ensuring accurate, compliant, timely, and well-controlled compensation for our workforce across Poland, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Norway, Spain, and Sweden, in line with each country's statutory pay cycle.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong><br><br><strong>Payroll Processing &amp; Systems Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the day-to-day end-to-end payroll process for employees across Poland, Singapore, the United Kingdom, Norway, Spain, and Sweden, partnering with in-country payroll providers and ADP Celergo and operating within the agreed governance and approval framework. Payroll scope includes base pay, commissions, bonuses, allowances, deductions, and other approved pay elements.</li> <li>Manage day-to-day relationships with ADP Celergo, assigned in-country payroll providers, and Employer of Record (EOR) providers; monitor delivery against agreed service levels; resolve operational issues; and escalate material service, compliance, contractual, or commercial concerns to the Global Payroll Manager.</li> <li>Maintain and monitor the international payroll calendar, including input deadlines, review dates, approval deadlines, funding dates, statutory payment dates, and year-end requirements.</li> <li>Prepare each payroll for approval, including a clear summary of material changes, exceptions, funding requirements, reconciliations, and identified risks, and obtain final approval from the Global Payroll Manager and other designated approvers before payroll or payment release.</li> <li>Operate in accordance with segregation-of-duties requirements so that no individual can independently prepare, approve, and release the same payroll or payment.</li> <li>Review and audit timesheets, attendance records, annual leave/PTO balances, and other country-specific inputs (e.g., UK statutory sick/maternity pay, Nordic parental leave, Spanish IRPF adjustments) to ensure accurate and compliant payment calculations prior to each payroll run.</li> <li>Coordinate and execute approved off-cycle payroll runs, retroactive pay adjustments, and manual payments across multiple countries and currencies, ensuring appropriate justification, review, approval, funding, and audit evidence.</li> <li>Oversee country-specific statutory deductions and employer obligations, including UK PAYE/National Insurance, Polish ZUS and PIT, Norwegian tax and folketrygd contributions, Spanish Seguridad Social and IRPF, Swedish tax and arbetsgivaravgifter, and Singapore CPF, in full compliance with applicable local laws.</li> <li>Coordinate payroll processing and reporting for RSU vesting, stock option exercises, and employee share purchase plan transactions for local and internationally mobile employees. Partner with Stock Administration, Legal, Global Mobility, and external tax advisers where cross-border tax treatment or specialist advice is required, and ensure timely payroll reporting and reconciliation.</li> <li>Support and monitor integrations and data flows between ADP Celergo, in-country payroll vendors, the general ledger, Workday HR, and benefits platforms, ensuring data integrity across multiple currencies, languages, and statutory calendars and escalating interface failures promptly.</li> <li>Manage payroll queries and escalations through the agreed case-management process, ensuring responses are accurate, appropriately documented, and delivered within established service-level expectations. Draft clear employee communications regarding payroll corrections, overpayments, underpayments, tax adjustments, and country-specific payroll matters, obtaining appropriate review for sensitive or material communications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance, Tax &amp; Risk Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain strong international payroll knowledge, with direct operational expertise in several of the covered countries and the ability to develop knowledge of additional jurisdictions through collaboration with in-country providers and specialist advisers. Proactively identify legislative or regulatory updates and coordinate required operational changes.</li> <li>Manage day-to-day multi-country payroll tax compliance activities across EMEA and APAC, including registrations, statutory filings, payment requirements, and routine correspondence with tax and social security authorities such as HMRC, ZUS and the Polish Tax Office, Skatteetaten, the Agencia Tributaria and Seguridad Social, Skatteverket, and Singapore's IRAS/CPF Board. Escalate material assessments, disputes, penalties, or compliance risks to the Global Payroll Manager.</li> <li>Support the Global Payroll Manager, Legal, Finance, Tax, and HR with new-country payroll assessments, registrations, implementation activities, documentation, testing, and operational readiness. Legal, tax, permanent-establishment, and employment-law determinations must be validated by the appropriate internal or external specialists.</li> <li>Review and reconcile statutory in-year and year-end payroll filings for each covered country (e.g., UK P60/P11D, Polish PIT-11, Swedish arbetsgivardeklaration, Norwegian a-melding, Spanish Modelo 111/190, and Singapore IR8A/IR21), prepare them for authorised approval, and partner with local tax representatives to resolve routine agency notices.</li> <li>Support the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of robust payroll controls to safeguard payroll data, comply with GDPR and local data-privacy requirements, and mitigate the risk of errors, fraud, or unauthorised access.</li> <li>Maintain complete payroll control evidence, approval records, reconciliations, issue logs, and audit trails for every payroll cycle in accordance with company record-retention requirements.</li> <li>Complete periodic payroll system and provider access reviews, bank-detail change controls, variance analysis, and post-payroll reconciliations, escalating control failures, suspected fraud, or unauthorised activity immediately.</li> <li>Coordinate day-to-day statutory and external audit activities related to international payroll, including preparation and management of payroll PBC (Prepared by Client) lists across jurisdictions, and escalate material findings or commitments to the Global Payroll Manager.</li> <li>Address and resolve payroll discrepancies, tax issues, and employee escalations across multiple time zones with urgency, accuracy, and professionalism.</li> <li>Partner closely with the Payroll Accountant and Finance team on payroll journal entries, multi-currency general ledger reconciliations, flux analysis, and accruals on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process Improvement, Training &amp; Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Champion continuous improvement by identifying, designing, and implementing process enhancements, automation opportunities, and best practices to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across a growing international payroll footprint.</li> <li>Support the implementation and continued optimisation of ADP Celergo, including requirements gathering, data validation, configuration review, interface testing, user acceptance testing, parallel payroll testing, defect management, go-live readiness, change management, and post-go-live stabilisation. Overall programme ownership and material design decisions remain with the Global Payroll Manager and designated project governance.</li> <li>Create, document, and maintain comprehensive country-specific payroll process manuals, SOPs, control documentation, key-contact lists, access instructions, contingency procedures, and training materials to ensure business continuity and knowledge transfer.</li> <li>Provide effective payroll cover across assigned countries and participate in cross-training to reduce dependency on individual team members or external providers during planned or unexpected absences.</li> <li>Provide functional guidance, coaching, and training to junior payroll team members on multi-country payroll practices, fostering a culture of accuracy, compliance, accountability, and professional development. familiarity with Workday HR (HCM) is a plus.</li> <li>Experience operating within documented payroll controls and audit frameworks, including SOX-style controls where applicable, with a strong understanding of segregation of duties and evidence retention.</li> <li>Working knowledge of GDPR and other local data-privacy requirements as they relate to international payroll processes and data security.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience coordinating and processing equity transactions, including RSU vestings, stock option exercises, and employee share purchase plan transactions, with an understanding of when cross-border or internationally mobile cases require support from tax, legal, mobility, or external advisers.</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail with an unwavering commitment to data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose root causes and implement sustainable solutions.</li> <li>Excellent organizational and time management abilities, with a proven capacity to manage multiple priorities and time zones under strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills; description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What does the team work on?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What is the role?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></h3> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p class="text-neutral-900 dark:text-neutral-200 my-2.5 last:mb-0 first:mt-0 ">&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="mt-6 mb-2 font-semibold text-xl" data-streamdown="heading-3"><span class="font-semibold" data-streamdown="strong">What are the responsibilities of the role?</span></h3> <ul style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center.
